items.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
items.desc: Free, private support from a trained counselor, 24 hours a day. For anyone who is struggling or worried about someone else.

items.name: Betty Hardwick Center
items.desc: The local mental health center for Callahan, Taylor, Jones, Shackelford, and Stephens counties.

items.name: Hendrick Medical Center
items.desc: Hendrick Health's main hospital, with an emergency room.

items.name: Hendrick Medical Center South
items.desc: Formerly Abilene Regional Medical Center. Now part of Hendrick Health, with emergency services.

items.name: ResourceCare (Clyde clinic)
items.desc: A community health center with a clinic in Clyde. Community health centers charge based on what you can afford.

items.name: Abilene Community Health Center
items.desc: A community health center run by the Texas Tech School of Nursing. Fees are based on what you can afford.

items.name: Abilene-Taylor County Public Health District
items.desc: Shots (immunizations), screenings, WIC, and other public health services.

items.name: Find a Health Center
items.desc: Search for federally funded health centers near you by ZIP code (try 79510 for Clyde).

items.name: Texas 2-1-1
items.desc: Free help finding food, housing, utility bills, health care, and more. Available 24/7.

items.name: Hendrick Regional Blood Center
items.desc: Abilene's community blood center, run by Hendrick Health. Blood donated here helps patients in our area. Holiday hours may change, so call ahead.

items.name: American Red Cross Blood Drives
items.desc: Find a Red Cross blood drive near you and make an appointment.

items.name: Donate Life Texas Registry
items.desc: Sign up online in about two minutes. It's free.

items.name: At the Texas DPS
items.desc: Say "yes" to organ donation when you apply for or renew your Texas driver license or ID card.

items.name: American Red Cross CPR Classes (Abilene)
items.desc: In-person, online, and blended CPR and first aid classes.

items.name: American Heart Association Class Finder
items.desc: Search for CPR and first aid classes taught near you.

items.name: Hands-Only CPR Video
items.desc: Learn the two steps of Hands-Only CPR in about 90 seconds. Free, no class needed.
